food
食物
What food would you introduce to someone visiting your hometown?
I would introduce a noodle soup from a small local shop. The food is simple, but the broth has a wonderful depth.
我會帶他吃附近小店的湯麵。食物雖然簡單，湯頭卻很有層次。
meal
一餐
What would you prepare for a quick meal after work?
For a quick meal, I would cook rice with eggs and vegetables. It uses one pan and leaves little washing up.
下班後想快點吃一餐，我會用蛋和蔬菜炒飯。只用一個鍋子，也不用洗太多東西。
breakfast
早餐
How do you manage breakfast when you need to leave early?
I prepare breakfast the night before when I have an early start. Overnight oats are easy to take with me.
隔天要早出門，我就前一晚準備早餐。隔夜燕麥很方便，拿了就能走。
lunch
午餐
Would you take lunch from home or buy it near work?
I take lunch from home most days to save money. On Fridays, I enjoy eating with my colleagues instead.
大部分日子我會帶午餐，比較省錢。星期五則喜歡和同事一起出去吃。
dinner
晚餐
How would you plan dinner for friends with different preferences?
I would serve dinner with several dishes people can combine themselves. I would check dietary restrictions before buying ingredients.
我會準備幾道能自由搭配的菜當晚餐。買食材前，也會先問大家有沒有飲食限制。
cook
煮
What would you like to cook without following instructions?
I would like to cook a good vegetable curry from memory. Learning the basic spice combinations would help me adjust it confidently.
我想學會不用看步驟就能煮出好吃的蔬菜咖哩。懂得基本香料搭配，就比較敢自己調整。
recipe
食譜
How do you decide whether to try an unfamiliar recipe?
I check whether the recipe uses ingredients I can find nearby. Clear steps and a realistic cooking time matter too.
我會先看食譜的食材能不能在附近買到。步驟清不清楚、時間合不合理，也很重要。
ingredient
食材
An ingredient in your recipe is unavailable. What would you do?
I would look for an ingredient with a similar texture or flavour. If the substitution seemed risky, I would choose another dish.
我會找口感或味道接近的食材替代。如果不確定換了會不會失敗，就改做別道菜。
taste
味道
How would you describe a soup to someone who has never tried it?
I would describe its taste as rich but not too salty. The ginger adds warmth without hiding the vegetables.
我會說它的味道濃郁，但不會太鹹。薑讓湯喝起來暖暖的，也沒有蓋過蔬菜的味道。
flavour
風味
What flavour reminds you of a particular place or person?
The flavour of roasted sesame reminds me of my grandmother's kitchen. She used it in noodles we ate after school.
烤芝麻的風味讓我想起奶奶的廚房。以前放學後吃的麵，她都會加一點。
fresh
新鮮
What would you check when buying fresh vegetables?
I look for fresh leaves and firm stems. I also buy smaller amounts so nothing sits in the fridge too long.
我會挑葉片新鮮、莖也挺的蔬菜。一次少買一點，才不會在冰箱放太久。
spicy
辣
How would you order at a restaurant known for spicy food?
I would ask for a mildly spicy dish first. I enjoy some heat, but I still want to taste the other ingredients.
我會先點微辣的菜。我喜歡一點辣味，但還是想吃得出其他食材的味道。
sweet
甜
Do you prefer a very sweet dessert or something lighter?
I prefer a dessert that is only slightly sweet. Fresh fruit with plain yogurt is usually enough for me.
我比較喜歡只有一點甜的點心。新鮮水果配原味優格，通常就很滿足了。
salt
鹽
A friend finds your cooking too salty. What would you change?
I would use less salt next time and taste as I cook. People could add a little extra at the table.
下次我會少放一點鹽，邊煮邊試味道。想吃重口味的人，再自己加就好。
sugar
糖
How could you reduce the sugar in a drink you enjoy?
I would order half the usual sugar and see whether I still enjoy it. I could adjust gradually rather than change everything immediately.
我會先把平常喝的糖量減半，看看能不能接受。不用一下子全改，慢慢調整就好。
portion
一份
What would you do if a restaurant served a much larger portion than expected?
I would eat a comfortable portion and take the rest home. There is no reason to finish everything just because it was served.
我會先吃剛好的一份，剩下的帶回家。不必因為店家端上來，就勉強全部吃完。
restaurant
餐廳
What makes you return to the same restaurant?
I return to a restaurant when the food is consistent and the staff are welcoming. A huge menu matters less to me.
餐廳的食物品質穩定、服務也親切，我就會再去。菜單選擇多不多，反而沒那麼重要。
menu
菜單
How do you choose when a menu has too many options?
I narrow the menu down to two dishes I genuinely want. Then I ask which one the kitchen recommends that day.
我會先從菜單挑出兩道真的想吃的，再問店家當天比較推薦哪一道。
order
點餐
Your meal arrives, but it is not what you asked for. What would you say?
I would politely explain that my order was different. I would show the receipt if the staff needed to check.
我會客氣地說明，這和我點餐的內容不同。店員需要確認的話，我也會拿出收據。
vegetable
蔬菜
How would you help a reluctant eater try a new vegetable?
I would serve the vegetable alongside something they already enjoy. A small taste feels less intimidating than a full plate.
我會把新蔬菜配在他本來就喜歡的食物旁。先試一小口，比整盤端上來容易接受。
fruit
水果
Which fruit would you take on a short day trip?
I would take an apple or an orange. This fruit travels well and does not need a container or refrigeration for a short outing.
短程出遊我會帶蘋果或柳橙。這類水果好攜帶，也不用另外裝盒或冷藏。
waste
浪費
How could your household waste less food?
We could waste less food by checking the fridge before shopping. Planning one meal around leftovers would also help.
買菜前先看看冰箱，就能減少食物浪費。也可以安排一餐，專門利用剩下的食材。
allergy
過敏
How would you explain a food allergy when eating somewhere new?
I would tell the staff about my allergy before ordering. I would ask them to check ingredients rather than guess.
點餐前，我會先告知店員自己的過敏狀況。請他們確認食材，而不是憑印象回答。
traditional
傳統
Would you change a traditional family dish or keep it exactly the same?
I would keep the traditional seasoning but adjust the portion size. That would preserve the familiar flavour without leaving too much food.
我會保留傳統的調味，但調整份量。這樣既有熟悉的味道，也不會剩下太多。
